concerns.text: FR‑004, FR‑005, and FR‑008 require Linear Mixed‑Effects Models (LMM) defined in R (lme4) with species as a random intercept. Tasks T005 and T006 implement Phylogenetic GLS models instead, leaving the mandated LMM unimplemented and thus the functional requirements are not satisfied.

SC‑001 specifies that the proportion of successfully merged records (≥ 90 %) must be recorded as a verifiable artifact (e.g., a CSV column or log entry). T004 only asserts the proportion in an inline assert without producing a persistent result file, so reviewers cannot verify the success criterion.
